name: @researchos/ui-research-upload
description: Phase 4 ui-research-upload (v0.1): out-of-tree client package — a conversation chat node triggered by a user message keyword (上传/upload/上传文献) that renders an upload panel: project/folder pickers + PDF file input; runs presign → multipart upload → create paper (triggers MQ analysis) and shows the resulting paper id + PROCESSING status.
